name: Diagnosis 2 ~Gouyoku no Note~
source:
Mamoru Kujou is just another otaku drowned in his own delusions. He thinks that Rika loves him as much as he loves her. But the reality is that Rika has a boyfriend named Shinya and they are bullying him together.
One day he picked up a notebook... a notebook that allows him to change his life.
translation:
九条守只是又一个沉溺于妄想的御宅族。他以为里见里香爱他，就像自己爱她一样。然而现实是，里香已有名叫信也的男友，两人还一起欺负守。
某天，他捡到一本笔记……一本能够改变人生的笔记。
